reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Purified NT/FL/CT on one generic plasma-membrane-like vesicle recipe, fluorescence leakage only.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

checks.quote: Ensure purity via SDS-PAGE and size exclusion chromatography
checks.reason: No matched mock purification/unrelated protein or native-cleavage source/carryover comparison distinguishes NT-specific contamination from intrinsic protein activity. Purity chromatography alone does not rule out a potent co-purified membrane-active contaminant.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.

checks.quote: baseline fluorescence increases by more than 5%
checks.reason: Five percent of unspecified baseline is not five percent of the full-release dynamic range; free reporter/protein interference and linear-range recovery are also untested.

checks.quote: Calculate the percentage of dye release
checks.reason: The denominator is mentioned, but baseline subtraction, weak/saturated measurement handling and aggregation-related missing observations are not operationally specified.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.
Operator blinding is present, but no randomized balanced plate/treatment allocation or processing order is specified.
No fixed attrition/denominator handling or bounded repeat policy preserves all original units and biologically negative preparations.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.
A concentration/lipid/time range is proposed without a bounded ladder or concrete derivation of bounds, an objective selection criterion and a lock before independent confirmation.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.

checks.quote: cannot disrupt standard lipid membranes on its own
checks.reason: A negative result on one vague lipid mixture with soluble protein does not identify an indirect mechanism, and full-length activity need not be artifact. The decision excludes legitimate lipid/context/precursor biology without a discriminating test.
No operational orthogonal electrical/structural/chemical readout validates direct membrane passage or a pore; repeating the same fluorescence does not remove its interference.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

The direct-versus-indirect question, minimal reconstitution logic and dequenching principle are useful and within format; proposed work is labeled. Conditional over-inference is charged specifically at P13, not again at G5. Protein identity and solubility are at least checked.

historical_match_reason: Direct-versus-indirect question and purified-lipid intervention align, but pore, extraction and detergent action are bundled without discrimination. Only fluorescence leakage is measured, with no orthogonal pore evidence; the outcome claims direct execution rather than an identified pore mechanism.
